thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: high_slo_burn detected for /generate-route (burn_rate=2.3, window=1h) :rotating_light:
alex.k: ack — oncall taking. looking at alert graph now.
priya.r: i'm seeing error spikes on model-serving-3 and a backlog on kube-node-12. 5xxs started ~14:03 UTC.
mike.s: any customer reports?
product-ops: a handful of customers reported higher latency, one support ticket opened by acme-inc — they see timeouts.
alex.k: starting mitigation checklist. adding debug tag to the service, will throttle new routes for non-critical tenants.
incident-bot: page sent to @sre-rotation (pager duty) at 14:08 UTC.
tara.p: on it, joining. what SLO are we burning to?
alex.k: per dashboard, `/generate-route` 99th latency target 500ms. current 95th ~2.1s. burn rate calculated vs 30d baseline.
jordan.l: logs show repeated model fetch timeouts from cache-populate job. KV cache misses jumped 3x.
priya.r: can we short-circuit cache warmup? maybe fall back to smaller model variant temporarily.
mike.s: +1 on fallback. rolling a config change to prefer quantized-variant-q4 for non-enterprise tenants.
alex.k: doing canary 2 nodes. deploying now:
```
kubectl -n inference set env ds/model-service VARIANT=quantized-q4 --selector=zone=east-canary
```
product-ops: noted — please keep me posted on customer-visible change.
incident-bot: EVENT: deployment started (deploy-bot id 78433).
tara.p: can someone attach the burn-rate query used in the alert rule? need to validate thresholds before we tune alerts.
jordan.l: here's the core query we use (PromQL):
```
(sum(rate(slo_errors_total{route="/generate-route"}[5m]))
 / sum(rate(slo_requests_total{route="/generate-route"}[5m])))
 / (SLO_target)
```
alex.k: quick metrics update: after canary, p95 dropped to ~640ms, p99 still ~1.6s. error rate decreased.
priya.r: cache warmup backlog draining, KV miss rate trending down.
mike.s: i'm going to close the immediate paging loop — system stabilized. recommend we not change paging rules mid-incident unless noise.
alex.k: agree. but post-incident we need to reduce alert noise and refine multi-window criteria. current rule fires on 1h burn_rate > 1.2. that's noisy for short blips.
product-ops: customers were impacted for ~22 minutes by elevated latency. we need an incident summary and followups.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: auto-notify sent to incident channel.
tara.p: handing over to next shift for cleanup and postmortem notes. @sre-rotation passing to @alex.k for write-up?
sre-rotation: confirmed handoff. thanks team.
--- 45 minutes later (post-incident triage) ---
alex.k: quick postmortem notes: root cause = cache-populate job causing simultaneous large KV loads which tripped model-serving threads and increased model fetch latency. mitigation = throttled populate job + fallback to quantized variant + rolling restart of hottest pods.
priya.r: impact: p99 latency spike, ~12% error increase for /generate-route during 14:02-14:24 UTC. customer-visible for ~22m.
mike.s: ACTIONS proposed:
- tune alert windows: require both a short window and a long window to trigger paging
- add dashboard panel for KV miss heatmap by node
- change paging criteria to only page for burn_rate > 1.5 sustained for 30m OR >3.0 for 5m
- create runbook step for throttling populate jobs
- run load test for cache warmup scenario

alex.k: drafting an alert rule patch (yaml):
```
- alert: SLOBurnHighGenerateRoute
  expr: max(
    (sum(rate(slo_errors_total{route="/generate-route"}[5m]))
     / sum(rate(slo_requests_total{route="/generate-route"}[5m])))
    / bool SLO_target,
    (sum(rate(slo_errors_total{route="/generate-route"}[30m]))
     / sum(rate(slo_requests_total{route="/generate-route"}[30m])))
    / bool SLO_target
  ) > 1.5
  for: 30m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "SLO burn for /generate-route (multi-window)"
```
priya.r: small nit: change `for: 30m` to `for: 25m` to avoid overlap with short blips caused by GC cycles.
tara.p: we should also add a short-window immediate alert with severity=warning so we surface flashes to dashboard without paging. e.g. 5m window > 2.0 => warning, no page.
product-ops: and please add notes for customer communications — timeline + mitigation + next steps.
jordan.l: created a Grafana dashboard PR with a KV miss heatmap + burn-rate overlay. link: https://grafana.redwood/s/dash/kv-miss-heatmap (PR 4127).
alex.k: created alert PR with adjusted thresholds and multi-window logic. requesting review from @pri.g and @mike.s.
incident-bot: NOTE: new alert rule created in staging. automated tests passing.
--- followup later same day ---
priya.r: quick check-in: after tuning in staging, false positives dropped by ~60% on canary traffic.
mike.s: moving changes to prod this afternoon. I'll run a 2h canary run.
tara.p: reassigning action items: @jordan.l dashboard, @alex.k runbook update, @mike.s prod rollout, @priya.r load test.
product-ops: thanks all — i'll prep a customer-facing blurb and send to ops@ and affected customers. :thumbsup:
alex.k: adding postmortem note in confluence and linking the thread. will include incident timeline and the SLO tuning rationale.
incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: no further activity for 6h.
